source.note: Contract is taken from implementation + the already-written adkm_s0 config. The run directory is not modified.

splits.strategy: patient-level, quintiles of event count, 70/10/20, seed=42

model_event_tuple.code_indices: [B, L] int64; PAD=0, UNK=1, real = vocab_index + 2
model_event_tuple.timestamps_days: [B, L] float64; days from the patient's first event; padded 0.0
model_event_tuple.demographics: [B, L, 9] float32; last-event vector is consumed by the head

timestamp.storage_dtype: float32 in shards; collate promotes to float64 for lag arithmetic

age_at_event.dob_mimic: July 1 of (anchor_year - anchor_age); see patients_demo in build_event_table.py

index_age.pretrain: not a single index date; each sample is a next-visit forecast window
index_age.pooling_age: age of the last valid input event (AttentionPooling.last_valid_index)
index_age.demographic_age: same last-event age, then z-scored in MinimalDKMModel.standardize_demo_age

token.string: rolled code_id with type prefix (PHE_, CCS_, RXN_, ...)
token.text_embeddings: frozen BGE-M3 1024-d table; row 0/1 are zeros for PAD/UNK

event_types_included.diagnosis: ICD9_/ICD10_ then PheCode PHE_ (unmapped ICD leftover kept)
event_types_included.hcpcs: HCPCS_ then CCS_ via the ICD-10-PCS CCS join (mostly leftover HCPCS_)

demographics.note: patient-level constants broadcast across the sequence; head uses last-event demo

event_representation.continuous_values: not used as sequence tokens; labs/charts are itemid presence only
event_representation.encounter: hadm_id defines visit blocks for the pretraining target; not an input feature

vocabulary.token_to_id: JSON object {token: int}; keys sorted alphabetically at BGE build time
vocabulary.id_to_token: inverse of code_vocab.json; embedding table code_ids = ['[PAD]','[UNK]'] + sorted tokens

UNK.note: unk_vocab_index = len(code_vocab) in shards; collate maps that id -> 1

code_systems.ICD-9 diagnosis: raw ICD9_<code> (no dots, as stored by MIMIC) or rolled PHE_
code_systems.ICD-10 diagnosis: raw ICD10_<code> (no dots) or rolled PHE_
code_systems.ICD-9/10 procedures: rolled CCS_ (231 categories); leftover PROC10_ exists, PROC9_ none in frozen vocab
code_systems.CPT/HCPCS: HCPCS_<code> leftover after CCS join against ICD-10-PCS (low yield)

normalization.icd_join: PheWAS maps joined on the normalized ICD body after stripping the ICD9_/ICD10_ prefix

vocabulary.rare_code_filtering: none at vocab build; vocab = every code that received a description after rollup
vocabulary.oov: codes missing from code_vocab.json map to unk_vocab_index = V, then model id 1
vocabulary.padding: collate left-aligns real events and fills the right with PAD=0; mask False on pad

temporal.event_order: subject_id, event_time, code_id (parquet); within a visit: event_time, code_id (tensorize)
temporal.equal_timestamps: stable secondary key code_id (and original index at window selection via lexsort)
temporal.lag_definition: tau_ij = log1p(|t_i - t_j| / c) with c = 7 days

tau_max.note: tau_max is recorded by corpus_stats for the obsolete DKM Chebyshev path (INV-TMAX). stage1_mimic_pretrain.config.tau_transform_spec sets tau_max_used=False and chebyshev_rescale=False. The live model consumes raw log1p(|dt|/7). NCH must still freeze this MIMIC tau_max for any diagnostic of temporal support; it must not be re-estimated.

temporal.clipping: none on tau in Stage-1 attention
temporal.max_history: no calendar window; count truncation only
temporal.padding_masking: build_pair_mask / build_key_mask; padded keys get -inf then 0 attention

stored_log_delta_t.formula: ln(1 + max(dt_consecutive_days, 0))  — NOT the model tau

age.age_at_event_vs_index: Every event carries its own age. Attention conditions on query age a_i. The prediction head uses the last input event's age (and its z-scored demo channel).

normalization.name: standardize_years
normalization.source: model_new.data.corpus_stats event-level moments on MIMIC train

two_sites.demographics: MinimalDKMModel.standardize_demo_age on channel 0 of last-event demo

how_age_enters_model: token sequence does not include age
age_years tensor -> lambda(a)=lambda0 + beta * z(a) in self-attention
demographics[...,0]=raw years; last event z-scored and projected (demo_proj) then concatenated onto pooled h

transform_spec.name: standardize_years
transform_spec.source: model_new.data.corpus_stats event-level moments on MIMIC train

sequence_construction.unit: one sample per (patient, next hadm-visit V_{m+1}) with ≥1 prior event
sequence_construction.index_event: start_time(V_{m+1}) = min timestamps in the target visit (strict past for input)
sequence_construction.history_inclusion: timestamp < target_time; ties go to the target (INV-HORIZON)
sequence_construction.min_events: raw table: ≥5 events and >1 unique timestamp per patient (build_event_table). tensorize: ≥2 visits. dataset: ≥1 pre-boundary event.
sequence_construction.padding: right pad to batch max length (not max_seq_len if shorter)
sequence_construction.duplicates: not dropped; identical (time, code) rows remain

splits.leakage_prevention: no subject_id overlap across train/val/test (asserted in adkm_s0 config)

pretrain_only.target: multi-hot codes of the next hadm visit; UNK dropped; duplicates collapsed
pretrain_only.head: PredictionHead over |V|=30635

spec.name: future_visit_codes
spec.input: events with timestamp < start_time(V_{m+1}) (strict); ties go to target
spec.target: multi-hot code set of hadm-visit V_{m+1}, UNK dropped
spec.horizon: next admission/visit; not a fixed calendar window
spec.masking: padding_only (not causal); target visit is outside the input window

encoder_inputs_stage2_must_reproduce: code_indices with PAD=0 UNK=1 real=id+2 using the frozen MIMIC vocab
timestamps_days in days (origin may be first event of the retained window; only differences matter)

must_reuse: MIMIC_AGE_MEAN_YEARS / MIMIC_AGE_STD_YEARS (or the adkm_s0 recorded mean/sd)
must_not_refit_on_nch: tau_max (even though unused by the live kernel)
